## Summary
<!-- What and why? -->

## Linked issue and acceptance criteria
<!-- List verifiable outcomes -->

## Implementation owner
- [ ] Claude implemented the changes on a feature branch

## Verification
- [ ] Existing automated checks run (list exact commands and results)
- [ ] Relevant regression scenarios tested
- [ ] iPhone/mobile behavior checked or explicitly marked not tested
- [ ] Offline/service-worker behavior checked or marked not applicable
- [ ] Data persistence, sync and backup checked or marked not applicable
- [ ] Accessibility and error states considered

## Safety and privacy
- [ ] No credentials, sensitive personal data or real user files included
- [ ] Authentication/authorization and XSS risk considered
- [ ] No destructive migration without rollback and owner consent

## Review and release
- [ ] ChatGPT independent review requested; findings addressed
- [ ] Limitations and untested scenarios stated
- [ ] Rollback documented
- [ ] Owner explicitly approves merge

**Do not merge while the PR is in draft or before owner approval.**
